spans.s: 1. śā-ta, pp. (√ 2. śā) sharp etc..
2. śāt-a, m. [√ śat] falling out (of hair 🞄or nails).
3. śāta, n. (?) joy, delight (rare).
sat-tá, pp. (√ sad) sitting.
sat-tā, f. being, existence: -vat, a. 🞄entitled to the predicate ‘being.’

sā-tá, pp. san;
 m. N. of a Yakṣa.
ś-at-ṛ, participial suffix -at (gr.).
sát-tṛ, m. sitter, esp. at the sacrifice 🞄(RV.).

śatá‿indriya, a. having a hundred 🞄senses (Br.);
 -īśa, m. chief of a hundred 🞄(villages).
śata‿ekīya, a. one of a hundred.
śatá‿ūti, a. bringing a hundred aids 🞄(V.).
śat-ya, a. consisting of a hundred.

śát-ru, m. [overthrower: √ śat] enemy, 🞄rival (V., C.);
 natural foe, immediately contiguous 🞄king (in policy, C.).
śatrū-ya, den. only pr. pt. -yát, behaving 🞄as a foe, hostile (V.).
śātakaumbha, a. (ī) id..

śātakratav-a, a. (ī) relating to 🞄Indra (Śatakratu): with śarāsana, n. rainbow;
 🞄with āśā, f. east.
śātapatha, a. (ī) relating or belonging 🞄to, based on, the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa.
śātamanyav-a, a. (ī) relating or 🞄belonging to Indra (Śatamanyu): w. āśā, f. 🞄east.
śātahrada, a. peculiar to lightning 🞄(śatahradā).
śāta‿ātapa, m. N. of a lawgiver.
śāt-in, a. [√ śat] clipper (of wings, —˚).
śāta‿udara, a. (ī) slender-waisted.
ṣa-tva, n. ṣ-ness, change of s to ṣ.
sa-tattva, n. real nature: -tas, ad. 🞄in reality.
sa-tas, ad. equally (only ˚—).

sa-tāpa, a. full of pain;
 -timira, a. 🞄enveloped in darkness.
sati, f. a metre.

sā-tí, f. (RV.) acquisition, gain, property;
 🞄winning of spoil.

sató-bṛhat, a. equally high or 🞄great (V.): -ī, f. a metre (12 + 8 + 12 + 8 syllables);
 🞄-mahat, a. equally great (RV.¹).
sát-tama, spv. best, first, chief of (g., 🞄—˚).
sat-tarka, m. orthodox system of 🞄philosophy.
sattra‿ayaṇá, n. sacrificial session 🞄lasting several years (Br.): -rūpa, n. characteristic 🞄of a long sacrificial session.
satyā-p-ana, (den.) n. ratification 🞄(of a bargain etc.).
satyā-p-aya, cs. den. (fr. satya) 🞄P. ratify.
sa-trapa, a. ashamed, bashful: -m, 🞄ad. bashfully.

satrā-jit, a. thoroughly victorious 🞄(V.);
 m. (C.) N. of a Satyabhāmāʼs father.

satrā́‿añc, RV. a. (ā́cī) [going together: 🞄√ añc] united, joint;
 concentrated, 🞄whole (mind, etc.).

sa-trāsam, ad. with terror, timidly;
 🞄-tvac, a. having its bark (staff).

sat-vát, m. pl. N. of a people in the 🞄South (Br.);
 = Yadavaḥ (C.).
sātvat, m. pl. (only in g.) N. of a 🞄people.
sát-van, a. [from sat] warrior (V.): 🞄pl. warriors, vassals, host.
sat-si, 2 subj. aor. √ sad.
sātat-ya, n. [satata] uninterruptedness, 🞄continuity, permanence: in. continually.

sāta-vāha, m. N. of a prince: -na, 🞄m. id.;
 -hán, a. destroying gain (AV.).

sa‿atireka, a. excessive;
 -atiśaya, 🞄a. superior, particularly good, pre-eminent.
sātyak-i, m. pat. (fr. satyaka) of 🞄Yuyudhāna.
sātyahavyá, m. [satyahavya] N. of 🞄a Vasiṣṭha (V.).
sātrājitá, m. pat. [satrājit] of 🞄Śatānīka.
